personality: 1 iOS-Native Clean with Modern Naturalism Botanical Theme
personality_one_liner: A clean, highly readable, and naturally calming interface that translates complex agricultural telemetry into actionable insights using deep forest greens and breathable white space.

spacing.rule: Generous vertical breathing room and clear grouping. Cards never flush to screen edges.

do's: Use on the bottom tab bar when content scrolls behind it.
Use on sticky headers over scrolling content.
Use over the greenhouse hero image for the featured status card.
dont's: Never apply to form fields or body text regions.
Never use on dense data rows or generic cards.

screens.name: Login
screens.purpose: A welcoming, secure entry point for the farmer/manager.

states.loading: Centered spinner with a 'Verificando credenciais...' message
states.error: Readable inline error for incorrect credentials

screens.layout: Hero image (indoor farming) covering the top 40% with a vertical gradient scrim (transparent to surface). Below the scrim, a clean single-column form (E-mail, Senha) with labels above inputs. Primary CTA 'Entrar' pinned to the bottom or bottom of the form.

screens.name: Dashboard (Home)
screens.purpose: Real-time overview of the smart greenhouse environment telemetry.

states.loading: Skeleton loaders for the metric cards and chart area
states.empty: Illustration of a greenhouse + 'Nenhum sensor conectado.'
states.error: Icon + 'Falha ao carregar dados da estufa.' + Botão 'Tentar novamente'

screens.layout: Top section: A glassmorphic hero card displaying the overall 'Status da Safra' (Crop Status) layered over a blurred greenhouse image. Below: A 2-column grid of sensor cards (Temperatura, Umidade, Solo, Luz, CO2). Each card displays the current value, a trend arrow, and an icon inside a brandTertiary tinted rounded square.

screens.name: Alerts (Notificações)
screens.purpose: Inbox for disease detection alerts triggered by the computer vision API.

states.empty: Illustration of healthy lettuce + 'Sua estufa está segura. Nenhuma doença detectada.'

screens.layout: A scrollable list. Each row requires a minimum 56pt height. Unread alerts have a 'warning' or 'error' (Terracotta) dot. The row layout includes a leading visual (small thumbnail of the affected plant or a system icon), Title ('Possível Míldio Detectado'), Date/Time, and a chevron. A segmented control (glass background) pinned at the top to filter 'Todas' vs 'Não Lidas'.

screens.name: Alert Detail
screens.purpose: Deep dive into a specific computer vision disease detection event.

states.error: Failed to load alert details + Retry button

screens.layout: Top half: The actual photo taken by the camera showing the lettuce crop, with an absolute positioned 'brandTertiary' pill indicating the confidence score (e.g., '94% de Precisão'). A top-to-bottom gradient scrim is mandatory so the back button and header title are readable. Bottom half: Scrollable area with the disease name, affected zone description, and a 'Recomendações de Ação' (Action Recommendations) section. A sticky CTA at the bottom 'Marcar como Resolvido' (Mark as Resolved).

screens.name: Settings (Perfil)
screens.purpose: Manage app preferences, greenhouse API configurations, and user profile.
screens.layout: Standard iOS-native settings layout. Section headers with subtle gray text. Rows have a leading tinted icon, label, and trailing chevron or toggle. E.g., 'Notificações Push' (toggle), 'Calibrar Sensores' (chevron).

login_hero.alt: Indoor vertical farming setup with lush green hydroponic lettuce under LED lights

dashboard_hero_bg.alt: Close-up of vibrant green lettuce rows in a well-tended agricultural field

alert_detail_sample.alt: Crisp green lettuce plants growing in an agricultural field

instructions_to_main_agent: Always use 'Plus Jakarta Sans' for text rendering. Respect the font weight cap of 500 max.
Implement the 'iOS-Native Clean' spacing rhythms: generous padding, clear grouping, and no dense dashboard-style clutter.
For the 'Dashboard' sensor cards, ensure they fill the horizontal space using the exact flexWrap and width calculation described in the guidelines (do not use width 48% with flex-start).

On the 'Login' and 'Alert Detail' screens, you must implement the gradient scrim pattern (Layer 0: expo-image, Layer 1: expo-linear-gradient, Layer 2: content). Text over images without a scrim is strictly prohibited.
Use Phosphor icons. Stick to a single weight (e.g., regular/outlined) consistently, except for the bottom tab bar where outlined=inactive and filled=active.
The disease alerts must use the defined 'error' (Terracotta #C84C31) or 'warning' (Ochre #D97706) colors to ensure they stand out against the botanical greens.
All strings and copy MUST be in Portuguese (Brazil) as requested by the user.
